RQ_TEXT: How are phenology-aligned climate exposures associated with district-level yields across five focal crops in Piura, and what prospective ENSO 2026–2027 yield risks do these associations imply for crop-specific outcomes and for two historically observed Rice–MAD reference configurations evaluated under a common scenario bank?
OBJECTIVE_TEXT: To characterize crop-specific associations between phenology-aligned climate exposures and district-level yields in Piura and, after separately frozen empirical-model and scenario designs, propagate those relationships through prospective ENSO 2026–2027 climate scenarios to characterize yield risk and compare two historically observed Rice–MAD reference configurations under a common scenario bank, with gross-production-value analysis retained only as a conditional extension subject to price-mapping and monetary-treatment gates.
TESTABILITY_CRITERION: All four specific objectives produce separately auditable outputs without merging the two analytical layers.

RQ_TEXT: What crop-specific associations link prespecified phenology-aligned precipitation and temperature exposures to district-level yield outcomes within each frozen temporal contract?
OBJECTIVE_TEXT: Characterize the crop-specific associations between prespecified phenology-aligned precipitation and temperature exposures and district-level yield outcomes within each frozen temporal contract.
TESTABILITY_CRITERION: Report crop-specific estimands, uncertainty, sample support, and diagnostics for every authorized model.

RQ_TEXT: How do crop-specific empirical climate–yield patterns and their uncertainty vary under prespecified comparison rules that respect differences in estimand, scale, sample support, climate channel, phenological window, and temporal architecture?
OBJECTIVE_TEXT: Assess heterogeneity in crop-specific empirical climate–yield patterns and uncertainty using prespecified comparison rules that respect differences in estimand, scale, sample support, climate channel, phenological window, and temporal architecture.
TESTABILITY_CRITERION: Use prespecified contrasts or descriptive comparison rules and disclose incompatible estimands or support.

RQ_TEXT: What prospective ENSO 2026–2027 yield-risk distributions arise from the separately specified scenario bank, and, if the price-mapping and monetary-treatment gates pass, what corresponding gross-production-value risk can be constructed?
OBJECTIVE_TEXT: Characterize prospective ENSO 2026–2027 yield-risk distributions and, only if the price-mapping and monetary-treatment gates pass, extend the authorized physical outcomes to corresponding gross-production-value risk.
TESTABILITY_CRITERION: Publish scenario provenance, support diagnostics, predictive distributions, and separate physical from monetary outputs.

RQ_TEXT: How do the two historically observed Rice-MAD reference configurations compare on 13 common districts when evaluated with the same prospective scenario bank and prespecified risk criteria?
OBJECTIVE_TEXT: Compare the prospective yield and conditionally authorized economic-risk profiles of C0B5-A2020-2021 and C0B5-A2023-2024 for Rice and MAD on their 13 common districts under an identical scenario bank and prespecified risk criteria.
TESTABILITY_CRITERION: Apply identical scenarios and metrics to both fixed alternatives without interpolation, optimization, feasibility, or recommendation claims.
